description:
*"It's been a while, Cha Ju-Ha?"*

Rookie actor Cha Ju-Ha reunites with his high school classmate Yeo Hyun-Jin, whom he once hated and loathed, as the lead in a BL web drama. Ju-Ha, who's been cast as the lead in his first drama since his debut, is brimming with enthusiasm, but he keeps making mistakes because of Hyun-Jin, who keeps hovering around him...

Heartbroken by his repeated mistakes, Hyun-Jin suggests that Ju-Ha practice his script. But is this even allowed in script practice?

*"Oh, huh... What are you doing?"

"You have to act like this to sound natural♡"*

Why does Yeo Hyun-Jin's dick keep touching his butt?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
